title: Construct Validity and Reliability SCUES
brief_summary: The aim of the study was to determine construct validity, discriminant validity and intra- and interrater reliability of the Selective Control of the Upper Extremity Scale (SCUES).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ages between 3-18 years
* Diagnosed as Cerebral Palsy (Hemiplegia)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants with an unstable situation regarding their tonus-regulating medications
* Participants had a botulinum toxin injection within the last 6 months, or any surgical correction within the last year
